type: independent product/customer-value projection over an explicitly synthetic 100-profile panel
reviewer: Product and customer-value lens; source-based assessment, no other reviewer grades consulted

runtime.runtime_diff_from_release: No src or supabase/functions diff in git inspection

method.name: Transparent task-group base plus explicit profile modifiers
method.formula: For each dimension d: score = clamp(0,100,segment_base[d] + sum(applicable_modifier[d])). overall = sum(score[d] × supplied_weight[d]) / 100. Per-profile overall is unrounded exact arithmetic on integer scores and percentage weights.
method.reference_profile: Desktop, readable PDF or DOCX, already has a real vacancy, 20 minutes, medium digital confidence, first-time, ordinary privacy. Segment base represents the goal; profile attributes apply once. All profiles request second-vacancy work, so no additional yes/no modifier is applied.
method.uncertainty: Integer dimensions are ordinal expert judgments, not measurements. Two-decimal arithmetic makes the formula reproducible, not the underlying judgments precise. Small score/rank differences should not be interpreted as meaningful; changing defensible base judgments can shift the result by several points.
method.independence: One authored product lens, not 100 independent people, model responses, sessions or observed tasks. No conversion, NPS, purchase, interview or employment predictions.
method.reliability_treatment: 77 is a bounded favorable technical-evidence judgment shared by profiles: v22 preservation, v23–25 fencing, tests/native concurrency/readback are credited. Hosted signup/OAuth/download delivery and provider output quality remain unknown; they are not asserted failed or passed. The 100 profiles are evaluated independently of pilot capacity; they were not admitted as 100 simultaneous cloud users.

assumptions: Panel contains 88 readable CV/text profiles, six scanned PDFs and six without CV; this is a scenario assumption, not traffic measurement.
Each profile is scored against its actual stated goal. Existing free second-vacancy reuse receives credit; missing check-to-Loop shared continuity is a different limitation.
Unknown current seats, configured provider/feed availability and external account behavior are neither invented nor reported as outages.
Free checks need no model and no account. Payment integration remains pending; no purchase-flow penalty is assigned to a free task.

Technical controls cannot by themselves demonstrate writing quality, customer demand, saved minutes or premium visual quality. No new screenshots/videos, production accounts or browser sessions were used.
U06/U07 are resolved within v22 regression scope and are not included as current defects. v23–25 backend repairs are explicitly credited.
The historical usability findings file was used only to locate hypotheses, then current source/release evidence was inspected. Past grades and other current reviewers were not consulted.

evidence.finding: Clear free on-device CV + vacancy > review > download primary proposition; no account/card gate. Example selector defaults to student and changes the CTA audience parameter.
Student/MBA/professional audience variants overlap, while examples and CTA guidance share selection state. This is a conceptual choice rather than a required difference in the core task.
Six clear named stages, original passages, editable final text, separate evidence report, approval and free PDF/DOCX/TXT exports. Role/company occupy the initial stage; vacancy text must be pasted.

Free checker is deterministic English-text comparison. Automatic editing ranks original bullets only within safely bounded experience blocks; it does not broadly rewrite, coach or translate career-switch narratives.
Readable PDF, DOCX and TXT import is implemented with 5MB/60,000-character limits. Scanned PDFs explicitly require external OCR or pasted readable text; OCR is absent.
No-CV users have a factual starter outline and help link, then write/paste their own career material; there is no guided blank-to-complete CV builder.

Free-check second-vacancy reuse exists, with source/final choice, collapsed input flow and undo. Unchanged source confirmation and rechecks preserve existing final edits after v22. Do not score reuse as missing.
Saving persists free-check source/final/vacancy separately; tracking independently stores role/company with an empty job URL. Saving does not create a shared Loop career record/application object.
Cloud Loop imports CV text and core details, then asks users to confirm reusable passages one at a time. Owned saved CV import is present; direct adoption of the approved free-check object is absent.

Each claim has evidence category, source quote/context, substantiated wording, result status and two confirmations. Guided mode copies passages, but confirmation remains passage-by-passage rather than exception-based.

Vacancy entry, manual tracking, run controls and output review are separate views. Opportunity row has no direct prepare-this-vacancy action. Packet CV text is read-only and corrections require source edit/rebuild.

Loop has a visible progress path, concrete next action and recorded activity. Capability/provider/budget and source configuration remain visible. Cloud preparation is limited to ten pilot accounts; no evidence that seats are currently full.
Public Loop page leads to free check, explains reusable work, selected employer feeds and private setup. Discovery is bounded, not whole-market UAE job coverage.
Signed-in header goes to /loop; normal sign-in has a separate destination convention.
Explicit Loop continuation is supported; ordinary account destination defaults to /dashboard. This does not establish that signup/OAuth currently fails.
Existing workspace separately exposes Your CVs, application packs, Applications and Packs & payments. Combined with free-check records and Loop, this fragments saved work across three concepts.
Exact PDF preview is a useful safeguard but resets approval; download and optional save share a busy flag. A pending optional save can temporarily block local exports.
Draft recovery has explicit tab-storage consent, owner binding, approval fingerprint and a separate consented Google handoff. Recovery is bounded rather than promised permanent.

Task-specific recorded videos, presenter overlay support, captions, chapters, interactive steps and transcript/failure fallback exist in source. Current playback quality and avatar realism were not re-evaluated.

U06/U07 fixed in v22 within local regression and deployed-readback scope; draft preservation and edit protection credited. General source replacement undo, tracking navigation and save/export separation remain partial.

v24 adds lifecycle-bound requests, mailbox state/refresh protection, no-activation reads, retained budget commitments and regression evidence. Backend reliability improvements are credited, not re-reported as unfixed defects.

v25 release/readback, bounded closed-path collection and six native PostgreSQL concurrency cases strengthen reliability evidence. Production collection stays disabled; hosted Storage acceptance, whole-account/restore rehearsal, fresh signup/full OAuth and unassisted candidate success remain unknown.

FAQ explains free access, formats, externally completed applications, current availability and limits. Paid tiers are proposals; absence of payment integration is not a penalty for the current free task.

segment_base_rationale.final_year: Project/internship evidence and the free first application fit this goal well; unsupported blank-CV cases are adjusted separately.
segment_base_rationale.recent_graduate: First document and manual tracking are useful, but multiple applications expose separate saved-check, tracker and Loop records.
segment_base_rationale.mba: Preserving project context is useful; translating prior work and MBA projects into a changed function still needs substantial personal editing.
segment_base_rationale.busy_same_function: Reusable facts, recurring preparation and tracking can save work; setup/review and three saved-work concepts limit the time-saving proposition.
segment_base_rationale.busy_switcher: Transferable-story development is materially more demanding than local wording comparison/reordering; Loop source changes require rebuild.
segment_base_rationale.urgent_search: Useful free preparation, but multiple urgent applications magnify entry/review overhead, pilot constraints and fragmented follow-up.
segment_base_rationale.uae_relocation: The product does not establish comprehensive UAE vacancy discovery, visa/eligibility reasoning or relocation-specific service. Discovery modifier applies when explicitly required.
segment_base_rationale.career_return: Source-grounded material and editing help, but a career-break narrative and targeting strategy remain largely manual.
segment_base_rationale.mobile_constraint: Neutral task base for preparing an application; phone effort is applied once through actual device modifier, not double-counted for segment label.
segment_base_rationale.privacy_constraint: Privacy boundary task receives strong source/approval credit; redaction/rebuild friction limits saved effort. Device/input/time modifiers remain separate.

profile_modifiers.rationale: Long source/final editors, pasted vacancy and passage review demand more effort on a phone. No browser failure is asserted.
A six-stage review plus separate reusable-fact setup fits a ten-minute window poorly. This is an ordinal effort judgment, not a timed session.
More review time improves fit for a manual evidence-led workflow; does not claim completion probability.
Source/final distinction, model/run/claim concepts and fragmented homes require more interpretation despite help.
A confident user is better equipped to use current editing and capability controls; no measured behavior is implied.
Previous exposure helps comprehension. Existing free-check reuse is credited; familiarity alone does not repair cross-system continuity.
Bypasses file import and format recovery.
External OCR or manual pasted transcription is needed. Error/help is explicit; this is a documented capability gap, not an asserted extraction bug.
A starter outline exists, but user must author factual source material; guided full CV construction is absent.

Main free path requires a vacancy; cloud selected feeds and optional search do not establish complete relevant-job discovery. Manual job sourcing remains work. Configured feed or provider outages are not assumed.
Local checking and scoped sharing align with privacy needs, while redaction/correction and repeated approvals add effort.

top_problems.title: One application has three possible homes
top_problems.consequence: A completed free check does not become a directly continued Loop application. Account destinations and legacy workspace concepts make returning users locate/rebuild context.
top_problems.action: Create one application record/home and explicitly continue the approved check there; preserve free-check reuse and current privacy/approval boundaries.

top_problems.title: Preparation requires fact administration before the promised time saving
top_problems.consequence: Repeated source/category/result/sharing review makes busy professionals and switchers do substantial setup; final cloud wording corrections require career-record rebuild.
top_problems.action: Propose grouped facts from the imported CV, review high-risk exceptions and edit a source-linked document in context with preserved provenance.

top_problems.title: Current tailoring contribution is smaller than the main promise suggests
top_problems.consequence: Local evidence comparison and safe bullet reordering are useful, but new-function positioning and CV creation remain manual; an unchanged CV can feel like little value.
top_problems.action: Show the exact proposed edit and why it helps, offer source-grounded alternatives with an inspectable diff, and measure useful accepted edits before stronger promises.

top_problems.title: Choosing a vacancy still does not directly prepare that application
top_problems.consequence: Users save an opportunity then move to generic run controls and output review. Discovery need groups first need a real job, not another preparation screen.
top_problems.action: Add a clear prepare-this-vacancy action, reuse imported target details, show selected source coverage before setup, and retain manual posting entry.

top_problems.title: The finish sequence makes users interpret implementation state
top_problems.consequence: PDF preview clears approval; optional save shares the download busy gate; six screens, duplicate full text reviews and provider/budget explanations add thought.
top_problems.action: Order finish as edit → actual preview → approve → download, isolate optional save state and put infrastructure detail behind service-status help.

top_problems.title: Audience choice and help should clarify tasks instead of creating categories
top_problems.consequence: Student and MBA examples overlap, selection changes CTA context, and phone/low-confidence users face long editors. Existing video/help assets do not prove unassisted usability.
top_problems.action: Use one common start and adapt examples after relevant experience is known; contextual help at friction points, with short task clips and a reduced phone review path.

recommended_validation: After one shared application continuation and grouped review are implemented, observe a small consented group completing first and second applications on desktop/phone; record task success, interruptions, edits accepted, active effort and source-quality errors. Re-score from that evidence rather than forcing a target.
